run.summary: Runs a vanilla command with the permissions of the app, collecting its outcome instead of printing it in chat.
params: the command, without the leading slash
run.returns: `list` — `[code, output]`: the return code and the lines the command produced.
examples:
result = system.run('data get entity @p Pos');
if(result:0 > 0, send(result:1));
run.note: It is the way out for what the curated API does not cover: everything it does have is faster and says what went wrong.

info.summary: Information about the server and the process it runs in.
params: optional: which piece — memory, threads, version, loaded mods, uptime, worlds, apps; without it, the list keys
info.returns: `list` of the keys, or the value asked for.

mob_counts.summary: How many mobs of each category are around, and how many the cap would allow.
mob_counts.returns: `map` from category to `[current, cap]`, or the single pair.

params: the entry inside the category, as `'minecraft:jump'`
statistic.returns: `num` — the value, `null` when there is no such statistic.

logger.summary: Writes a line to the log of the server.
logger.note: It goes to the console and to `latest.log`, where it stays: `send` only reaches whoever is playing right now.
